payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort the three health values; then check if divisible by 9 and if (sum of top two)//8 > smallest. Output NO if either fails, else YES.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the three numbers to identify the largest and applies arithmetic conditions based on sorted order. No custom key or sweep is used, but sorting is the only algorithmic step; thus sorting_custom_key is the best match among the given subtypes.
